title: Sylvan Crown — 16-Bit Real-Time PvP Fantasy Arena
author: Mrbuttshaman
selftext: For this one I was just messing around while I was working.  I used google AI studio, prompted it with some random action rpg style pvp stuff.  Just kept prompting it to add more chaos, more weird things for the stages, traps, disasters, etc.  Asked for stupid announcer stuff, 8 ai random players by default. Crazy potions that give things, random match wide effects.  Gold spawns, mobs, and a store between rounds. Eventually you got too overpowered so then I had it cap at 10 rounds and then a full reset.  I did add a secret console command on this one(press tilde) and type a secret vibe coding meme phrase, see if you can find it.
